about: Godot port story missions, played in order (Director). type clear = knock down the squad at `at` [x, z]; type reach = get to `at`, optionally in a given vehicle, optionally within `time` seconds, `air` = a ring in the sky for the CR-A1.

missions.title: First Night
missions.objective: Take down the Red Hand thugs in the dumpster alley west of the start

missions.title: Merc Yard
missions.objective: Break up the Black Ledger weapons yard east of the start. Use cover, smoke and the shield

missions.title: Interceptor Run
missions.objective: Call the CR-X1 (V) and reach the north-east corner of the city in 75 s

missions.title: Bike Launch
missions.objective: Drive the CR-X1, eject the CR-B1 (X) and reach the south-west checkpoint on the bike in 90 s

missions.title: Specter Patrol
missions.objective: Take the CR-A1 from Citadel Square and fly through the ring over the south avenue

missions.title: Red Hand Kingpin
missions.objective: Raid the Red Hand stronghold in the north-west blocks
